summary: Scope GitHub read fallback cache eligibility to individual requests

rules.detail: PAT write identity and read authorization rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: An intentional PAT legacy-status read no longer disables the enclosing batch's installation GraphQL detail cache. Each response carries its own request-and-redirect-chain cache eligibility; real fallback invalidates only that request's cache contribution.

recovery.detail: Normal binary rollback; no durable schema changes.
